items.t: Is Freeport McMoRan (FCX) About To Transform U.S. Copper Supply With $4.5 Billion?
items.sum: Freeport-McMoRan (NYSE:FCX) approved a US$4.5b expansion at its Bagdad copper and molybdenum mine in Arizona. The Bagdad project is expected to more than double current output once the enlarged operation is fully up and running.
